definitions.explanation: A day considered favorable for undertaking important activities such as weddings, moving house, opening a business, or other significant events. Based on traditional calendar systems and superstitions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大安|たいあん}→大安：16753_taian⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{吉日|きちじつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Taian is considered an auspicious day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{吉日|きちじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}いたい→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: I want to hold the wedding on an auspicious day.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日取|ひど}り→日取り：12952_hidori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{吉日|きちじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: We chose an auspicious day for the moving date.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大安|たいあん}{吉日|きちじつ} (most auspicious day on the six-day calendar)
- {吉日|きちじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧ (choose a lucky day)
- {吉日|きちじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ (carry out on an auspicious day)

Also read as きちにち. The traditional ⟦{六曜|ろくよう}→六曜：29161_rokuyou⟧ (six-day) calendar cycle determines which days are considered lucky or unlucky. ⟦{大安|たいあん}→大安：16753_taian⟧ is the most auspicious day, while ⟦{仏滅|ぶつめつ}→仏滅：16754_butsumetsu⟧ is the most inauspicious. Many Japanese still consult the calendar for weddings and other ceremonies.
